body:
## Problem

Since https://github.com/neovim/neovim/pull/40325 , cmdwin is now much more versatile, and could be used to replace Ex-mode (aka `gQ`). (Note for drive-bys: this is unrelated to "Ex commands").

"Ex mode" is a special mode where the user stays in `:` cmdline-mode and can run commands like a "shell", without having to explicitly re-enter cmdline-mode via `:`.



## Expected behavior

Delete all the Ex-mode special logic and provide Ex-mode instead as a tiny script which leverages cmdwin. https://github.com/neovim/neovim/discussions/40955

Here's a quick hack, though we likely will need to refine it:

```lua
  vim.api.nvim_create_autocmd('CmdwinEnter', {
    callback = function(ev)
      local caller = vim.fn.win_getid(vim.fn.winnr('#'))
      local run = function()
        local line = vim.api.nvim_get_current_line()
        if line == '' then return end
        vim.api.nvim_win_call(caller, function()
          vim.cmd(line)
        end)
        vim.fn.histadd('cmd', line)
        vim.api.nvim_buf_set_lines(ev.buf, -1, -1, false, { '' })
        vim.api.nvim_win_set_cursor(0, { vim.api.nvim_buf_line_count(ev.buf), 0 })
      end
      vim.keymap.set('n', '<CR>', run, { buffer = ev.buf })
      vim.keymap.set('i', '<CR>', function() run() end, { buffer = ev.buf })
    end,
  })
```

## Eliminate

```
do_exmode           # eliminated by #40966
exmode_active       # big one
getline_equal(...getexline)
input_start()       # ?
```

See also https://github.com/neovim/neovim/issues/40966


## NOT Eliminated

```
getexline       # Used by ":@" and the debugger ">" prompt.
                # TODO: migrate ":@" to a plain getline?
exec_from_reg   # Used by ":@".
silent_mode     # Used by "nvim -l".
```


## Compat chart

<details>
<summary>Chart (click to expand)</summary>

| Ex-mode behavior                                                                 | Source                                                                   | cmdwin keep-open                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Persistent `:` prompt, no re-`:`                                                 | `do_exmode:284` loop                                                     | ✅ native — this is exactly the keep-open `<CR>`                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Full editing of the pending command                                              | `getexline` (teletype-limited)                                           | ✅ **improvement** — real buffer, motions, insert, history nav                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Commands run against caller buffer, `.` = caller cursor, ranges & cursor-advance | `do_cmdline` on curwin                                                   | ✅ native via `nvim_win_call(caller, …)`                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `:visual`/`:vi`/`:view` exits the mode                                           | `do_exedit:6136-6139`                                                    | ⚠️ scriptable — intercept those cmds → close cmdwin (`M.confirm` path)                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **Auto-print current line** after cursor-move or buffer-change                   | `do_exmode:301-318` (`print_line_no_prefix`)                             | ⚠️ must reimplement — compare `changedtick`+`w_cursor.lnum` before/after, `nvim_echo` the line. (`ex_no_reprint`, `ex_pressedreturn`)                               |
| Empty line → `:+` (advance & print); bare range prints                           | `parse_command_modifiers:2564-2573`, `ex_range_without_command:2493`     | ⚠️ must reimplement explicitly (empty `<CR>` → `.+1` + print)                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `E501: At end-of-file` on `<CR>` past EOF                                        | `do_exmode:320-325`                                                      | ⚠️ trivial to replicate or drop                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Teletype scrolling output, **screen not redrawn per command**                    | `RedrawingDisabled++`, `msg_scroll=true` (`:280,290`)                    | ❌ **deliberate divergence**: `:p`/`:#` output lands in the message area (ui2) instead of scrolling. |
| `:global/pat/visual … Q` re-enters Normal per match, `Q` resumes `:global`       | `do_exmode:275 global_busy`, `do_exedit:6146-6166 pending_exmode_active` | ❌ **not faithfully reproducible** — deep reentrancy into the `:global` loop.                                                                                                                                                           |
| Running from a register strips leading `:`                                       | `getexline:3153-3156 exec_from_reg`                                      | ❌ minor edge case; lost unless replicated                                                                                                                                                                                              |


</details>

Note: 

- `gQ` is the "interactive Ex-mode.
- We can also replace non-interactive Ex-mode, tracked in: https://github.com/neovim/neovim/issues/40966
